name: ask-sales-v5-9-final-promotion-gold-2026-07-27
knowledgeSnapshot: frozen V5.9 full governed operational corpus, approved FAQ bundle, source-resolution rules, exact-record recovery, relationship-aware retrieval, follow-up resolver, and passive-action router at the runtime freeze commit

notes: All 17 parent source IDs were checked against every earlier Ask Sales test and runtime artifact and had zero matches at seal time.
The source threads were read directly from Slack and excluded peer-only, unresolved, screenshot-dependent, joke, malformed, live-status, and unrealistic chatbot prompts.
All policy prompts map to exact records in the frozen V5.9 knowledge snapshot; three prompts intentionally require routing because the passive chatbot cannot perform the requested live action.
Five prompts are controlled by Rich: the majority-owner conversation, split-down-payment rule, no-show reapplication rule, and daily-stats closed-call definition.
No banking details are included in the gold answer or evaluation output; requests for current wire instructions must route to Finance.
This dataset is invalidated as promotion evidence if V5.9 is tuned after any runtime output is inspected.

cases.question: The system already sends a preparation email before Call 1. Should I stop sending the required manual email and text so the prospect does not get duplicates?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Continue sending the mandatory email and SMS before the meeting. If the automated messages appear duplicative or incorrect, report that separately to Sales Tech rather than skipping the required rep communications.
requiredConcepts: continue the mandatory email and SMS
report an automation issue to Sales Tech
forbiddenConcepts: the automated email replaces the mandatory process

cases.question: A greenlit prospect wants a third follow-up call before deciding. How many calls can I give them before moving on?
cases.goldAnswer: Three calls is the maximum after the prospect has been greenlit. If the third call still ends without a commitment, move on; this limit is not stated as applying before greenlight.
requiredConcepts: move on if there is no commitment
forbiddenConcepts: the limit always starts before greenlight

cases.question: At what point in the sales process should I show the media kit: the end of Call 1 or during Call 2?
cases.goldAnswer: Follow the approved process and show the media kit at the end of Call 1. Do not move the standard media-kit step to Call 2 merely to check whether the prospect reviewed it.
requiredConcepts: show it at the end of Call 1
forbiddenConcepts: the standard step is during Call 2

cases.question: A lead booked directly onto my calendar but their application details are blank. Should I cancel the Call 1?
cases.goldAnswer: No. This can happen when the applicant does not complete the Typeform. Run Call 1 and ask the appropriate questions to understand the person, their business, and their fit.
requiredConcepts: incomplete Typeform can cause missing details

cases.question: A prospect is asking for verified audience demographics and Nielsen-style data before Call 1. What can I provide?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not claim that ISTV provides granular audience demographics or Nielsen-style data. The approved framing is that ISTV is a TV studio with U.S. traffic, not a marketing firm providing that level of audience analytics.
requiredConcepts: do not provide granular demographics or Nielsen data

cases.question: Are nonprofit organizations automatically disqualified from the shows?
cases.goldAnswer: No. A nonprofit can be a good fit when it is legitimate and has some form of social proof. That does not guarantee approval; normal fit and decision-maker checks still apply.
requiredConcepts: nonprofits can be a good fit

cases.question: Does any OnlyFans account disqualify an applicant, even if it is private and not promoted anywhere?
cases.goldAnswer: The confirmed disqualification applies when the OnlyFans account is public and actively marketed, especially when it appears across the applicant's social media or is linked in their bio. The source does not establish that every private, unmarketed account is automatically disqualifying.
requiredConcepts: public and actively marketed is disqualifying
do not generalize to every private account
forbiddenConcepts: every private unmarketed account is definitely disqualifying

cases.question: The client emailed me a bank-transfer receipt, but ISTV has not confirmed the funds yet. Can I post the Pay Me now?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Wait for confirmation from the company that the bank transfer went through before posting the Pay Me. A client receipt alone is not the required internal confirmation.
requiredConcepts: do not post Pay Me yet
forbiddenConcepts: post from the client receipt alone

cases.question: A prospect can only put $500 down today and wants to split the rest of the down payment later. Can I approve that arrangement?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Do not split the required down payment. Rich also advised against selling when the proposed arrangement shows that money is this tight; use only approved payment plans.
requiredConcepts: do not split the down payment
Rich advised against selling when money is that tight

cases.question: A prospect missed Call 2 because they were one hour off, then rebooked for the next day. Can we keep that new appointment?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Rich confirmed that the no-show policy applies in this scenario: cancel the immediate rebooking and the prospect must wait 90 days, which is three months, before reapplying.
requiredConcepts: do not keep the next-day rebooking

cases.question: For daily stats, does 'Total Closed Calls' mean every completed meeting that showed up?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Rich defined a closed call as one where payment was collected or the contract was signed; a meeting that merely showed and finished is not a closed call.

cases.question: Please create a same-day Green Light approval letter for my Call 2 this afternoon.
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot create or send a live Green Light letter. Post the request and required recording in #greenlight-requests so the Green Light team can confirm availability and prepare it.
requiredConcepts: cannot create or send the letter

cases.question: Can you send my client the current ISTV wire-transfer instructions right now?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot send or verify live banking instructions. Use #finance-requests to obtain and send the current approved wire details; do not rely on old account information copied from chat history.
requiredConcepts: cannot send or verify live banking instructions

cases.question: Can you add me to the ISTV dummy-calls pass-off Slack channel?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot change Slack channel access. Submit the access request in #sales-tech-requests so the appropriate team can add you or explain any eligibility restriction.

conversations.title: Majority owner and featured minority partner

prompts.question: The majority owner gave a small ownership stake to a partner who would be the face of the episode. The majority owner will pay but does not want to be featured. How should we handle the calls?
prompts.goldAnswer: Have both the majority owner and the featured partner attend Calls 1 and 2. The majority owner can pay and sign the partner up for onboarding, and fulfillment must be told whose name should be used for the show.
requiredConcepts: majority owner pays and signs the partner for onboarding
tell fulfillment about the featured name
forbiddenConcepts: the minority partner can handle everything alone
the majority owner must be the featured person

prompts.question: Does the majority owner also have to appear in the actual episode?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. In this scenario the smaller-stake partner may be the person featured in the episode. The majority owner still needs to be involved in Calls 1 and 2 and in payment and onboarding authorization.
requiredConcepts: majority owner does not have to be featured
majority owner still attends both calls
forbiddenConcepts: majority owner can be absent from the sales process
only the majority owner may appear

prompts.question: Can we audition a business owner who does not speak English if one of our reps speaks their language?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. The current process cannot accommodate non-English-language casting, so do not audition that owner directly merely because a rep can translate.
requiredConcepts: do not audition the non-English-speaking owner directly
forbiddenConcepts: translation by any rep makes the owner eligible

prompts.question: What if their English-speaking teammate can do it instead?
prompts.goldAnswer: That works only if the English-speaking person is a business partner or part owner. An ordinary employee or teammate is not enough under this exception; audition and cast the qualifying partner instead.
requiredConcepts: must be a business partner or part owner
forbiddenConcepts: the non-English owner can be cast through an interpreter

conversations.title: Social clips versus the full YouTube episode

prompts.question: Can cast members post chopped clips or reels from their episode on social accounts they own?
prompts.goldAnswer: Yes. They may post clips or chopped reels on social-media assets they own without asking for separate permission. This permission does not cover selling the content to third-party streaming platforms.
requiredConcepts: clips or chopped reels are allowed
forbiddenConcepts: they may sell the content to streaming platforms

prompts.question: Does that mean they can upload the full episode to their YouTube channel too?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. The permission covers clips, not the full episode. They cannot upload the full episode to YouTube under this rule.
requiredConcepts: full episode cannot be uploaded to YouTube
forbiddenConcepts: the full episode is allowed without restriction
nothing at all can be posted
